start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Verdict
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Pilate washes his hands of you.
The crowd roars: "Crucify him!"

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Not curses. The cup is yours.
[TODO:pt-BR] You bow your head in peace.
[TODO:pt-BR] The Father's will is the verdict.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] No Curse, Only Cup
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Even now, love is your answer.
Receive what the Father gives.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You bow your head in peace.

plead_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Cup Is Mine
plead_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You came for this hour.
Do not turn from it now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You set your face like flint.

carrying.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Weight of the Beam
carrying.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Rough wood bites your shoulder.
The road to Golgotha rises ahead.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] One step. Then another.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Carry it step by trembling step
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You move forward in silent love.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Rage at the soldiers around you
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Strength is in surrender now.

drop_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] One Step More
drop_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Every step is a gift you give.
Lift the wood and walk.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Carry it step by trembling step
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Your feet press into the dust.

rage_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Strength in Surrender
rage_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Wrath would shatter the sacrifice.
Walk in quiet power instead.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Carry it step by trembling step
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You breathe and step forward.

simon_scene.title: [TODO:pt-BR] A Stranger's Shoulder
simon_scene.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You stumble. Soldiers seize Simon.
They force him to share the beam.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Receive his help with grace.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Wave him off and walk alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Love does not refuse help.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Meet his eyes with quiet thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Simon's strength carries you on.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Receive the Help
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Even the Savior leans on kindness.
Let him bear the wood with you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Meet his eyes with quiet thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Simon nods and walks beside you.

alone_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] No One Walks Alone
alone_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Pride hides under solitary pain.
Accept the hand the Father sends.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Meet his eyes with quiet thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The weight lifts a little.

golgotha.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Place of the Skull
golgotha.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The hill rises grey and bare.
Soldiers lay the cross at your feet.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Refuse the bitter wine they offer
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You taste the cup fully, unclouded.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Drink to dull the pain to come
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The cup must be drunk awake.
[TODO:pt-BR] This hill is your throne.

drink_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Awake to the End
drink_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Love refuses the easier path.
Drink only the Father's cup.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Refuse the bitter wine they offer
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You shake your head and rise.

turn_back_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] This Is the Throne
turn_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The hill is where mercy is made.
Climb the last steps.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Refuse the bitter wine they offer
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You walk to the wood waiting.

nailed.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Father, Forgive Them
nailed.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Iron drives through wrist and foot.
Soldiers gamble for your robe.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Cry out a curse upon them
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Mercy speaks louder than wrath.
[TODO:pt-BR] Your prayer falls like rain.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Plead one last time for freedom
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Stay. The work is being done.

nail_curse_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Mercy, Not Wrath
nail_curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] From the cross, only love.
Speak forgiveness, even now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The soldiers fall silent below.

plead_free_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Work Is Being Done
plead_free_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Freedom for the world is here.
Not in escape, but in this hour.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Your voice carries down the hill.

criminals.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Two on Either Side
criminals.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] One thief mocks you in his pain.
The other whispers, "Remember me."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Answer hatred with grace.
[TODO:pt-BR] A penitent heart deserves answer.
[TODO:pt-BR] Paradise opens for the broken.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Grace, Not Scorn
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The cross is no place for mockery.
Let mercy be your only voice.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The thief weeps and breathes deep.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Answer the Penitent
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A whispered faith must be met.
Speak the promise of paradise.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Hope blooms beside your cross.

mary_below.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Mother and Beloved
mary_below.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Your mother stands below in tears.
John holds her trembling shoulder.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Their pain deserves your gaze.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Curse the day you were born
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Bless, do not curse, even now.
[TODO:pt-BR] John draws Mary close to himself.

look_away_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] See Them
look_away_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Even on the cross, you give.
Give them to each other.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Their tears soften into love.

curse_birth_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Bless, Not Curse
curse_birth_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You were born for this hour.
Bless the ones still standing.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Mary lifts her eyes to you.

final_breath.title: [TODO:pt-BR] It Is Finished
final_breath.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The sky darkens. Your strength fails.
One last breath waits inside you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] End in trust, not in fury.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Beg the Father to undo it
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The yes was spoken in the garden.
[TODO:pt-BR] Peace rushes through the dark.

scream_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] End in Trust
scream_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Wrath cannot finish the work.
Only surrender can.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Your breath softens into peace.

undo_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Already Yes
undo_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The garden's yes still holds.
Let the body follow the heart.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Quiet floods the hill.

ending.title: [TODO:pt-BR] It Is Finished
ending.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The veil tears. The earth trembles.
Your breath gives way to love itself.
